self.title: Cycle 33 · Revision of Memory-Based Preference Hypothesis and Experimental Protocol

detail.title: Revision of Memory-Based Preference Hypothesis and Experimental Protocol
detail.summary: This proposal refines the hypothesis regarding memory-based preference emergence by introducing a comparative control (memory-augmented vs. non-memory agent) to isolate the contribution of episodic memory buffers from stochastic policy noise. It includes a revised hypothesis definition and a new experimental protocol to advance project proj-mem-pref-01.
